pattern.name: Sheltered seagrass meadow
pattern.description: Sparse swaying eelgrass blades at the upper-right and lower-right canvas edges; quiet habitat marks behind the approved seahorse, not an underwater illustration.

framing.note: Preserve the exact approved off-center portrait and intentional lower neck entry. No rescaling, recentering, continuation or contour repair. Inspect crown, eyes, snout and complete side fin separately against the rounded outline.

matte.calibrationNote: Exterior background samples range from RGB 250,252,252 to 252,251,253. Use border-connected extraction only, preserving enclosed eye highlights and chromatic pale mint/cream facets. No connected-component deletion.
